messages:
maria: Quick sync — FinCo asked for an "Optimize" pilot that can do two things: 1) recommend quantization profiles per-model/workload, and 2) trigger eval-based alerts when quality regresses. They want something they can trial in 8 weeks. Can we scope a mini-pilot that lands value without shipping full auto-batching?

ajay: Sounds reasonable. 8 weeks is tight. I think we can do a recommendation UI + low-risk eval-alert plumbing. Full auto-batching and cache rewrites should be deferred.

lucas: +1. To be concrete: pilot MVP = (A) quant recs with simple cost/latency delta estimates, (B) eval-triggered alerting tied to an existing eval set, and (C) a lightweight opt-in telemetry flag for customers to surface model/seq-length histograms. No runtime changes initially.

helen: Agree with Lucas. For launch criteria we should require: 1) quant recs validated on >=3 internal workloads with measured token-cost improvements, 2) alerting fires correctly on a synthetic regression and a real customer regression case, 3) basic UX in Console to view rec and toggle alerts.

maria: That sounds like a clean cut. Prioritization tradeoffs: we lose some unit-cost upside if we don't ship batching+cache early, but we reduce risk and unblock customers fast. FinCo cares about predictability > max cost savings.

ajay: Implementation notes: quant recs can be offline analysis that outputs a pack of {model,quant-profile,expected-latency,expected-cost-delta}. We can expose that via the API + Console. Eval alerts: wire into existing eval runner and add a webhook/Slack action + console config.

lucas: Suggestion: make recs graded: "safer" (int8 w/ calibration), "aggressive" (int4/qlf) with expected quality delta. Include a simple A/B rollout recipe in recommendations so customers can try on a small % of traffic.

helen: UX checklist (short): - recommendation card (profile + expected impact) - confidence score + example prompt where it was tested - toggle + rollout slider - alert rule page (eval set, threshold, notification).

maria: Product acceptance (MVP gate): Passes internal smoke on 3 workloads, docs + quickstart, 1 pilot customer engaged and running. If any of the three fail we keep as "beta internal".

ajay: Dev asks: need sample eval sets from FinCo (anonymized) and a short SLO for false-positive alerts. Also need infra: storage for rec artifacts and a small background jobs pool.

maria: I'll ask FinCo for an anonymized sample and confirm SLO. Lucas/Eng: can you size the infra? If we target low throughput (pilot), a single small queue + 2 workers should be fine.

lucas: We'll size at T-shirt: pilot = 2 workers (cpu light), staging job + 1 persisting store. If we see >5 pilot customers we autoscale plan.

helen: Timeline proposal: Week 0–1: collect eval sets & define metrics. Week 2–4: build offline quant analyzer + UX for recs. Week 5–6: integrate eval-alert plumbing + notification. Week 7: internal smoke + docs. Week 8: customer pilot kickoff.

maria: Approve timeline. Decision: scope pilot as above (quant recs + eval alerts + Console UX + low-risk rollout controls). Defer batching/cache engine and runtime rollout. Action items assigned: Maria -> get evals + FinCo OK; Ajay -> infra & jobs; Lucas -> quant analyzer + A/B recipe; Helen -> UX mocks + console pages.

deploy-bot: :white_check_mark: Deployment ticket created: PROD-7891 (Optimize mini-pilot infra).

maria: Thanks everyone — will follow up with calendar invite and a concise spec doc. If anyone wants to push batching earlier, flag with concrete risk/cost mitigations by EOD Friday.
